title: Crush Zone
seo_title: Crush Zone Monster Truck Shows in Lebanon, MO
description: Crush Zone is a monster truck show where you can watch the trucks in action at the Kenneth E. Cowan Civic Center, with two shows planned for January 8-9, 2027. The Friday, January 8 show starts at 7:30 PM at Cowan Civic Center, 500 East Elm Street in Lebanon, Missouri.
